name: Wing-It
effect: Add result to your Total

name: Heal
effect: Heal HP by that much.

name: Taunt
effect: Target receives the Taunted Status Effect; Must target Taunter with Combat Action or lose Combat Action

name: Study
effect: Learn Stats of Target; Margin determines how much you learn.

name: Guardian Angel
effect: Heal allies that much in total, split as you wish

name: Ketchup
effect: Roll Severity; on 4's gain and distribute 10 points of temporary Readiness to a Target.

name: Slowed
effect: Target receives the Slowed Status Effect; Any movement costs an Action instead

name: Bind
effect: Target receives the Bound Status Effect; Cannot take movement actions

name: Weighted
effect: Roll Severity; on 4's gain and remove 10 points of temporary Readiness from a Target.

name: Blood Rage
effect: On evens, gain 6 to your Total. On odds, lose 1 HP.

name: Boon
note: Add xd4 to a Target's Total
effect: Add to the Target's Total

name: Curse
note: Remove xd4 from a Target's Total
effect: Remove from the Target's Total

name: Usurp
effect: Target removes that many Wound Dice from its Severity Roll

name: Reviver
effect: Revive downed Target

name: Marked
effect: Target receives the Marked Status Effect; Cannot be Hidden

name: Stun
effect: Target receives the Stunned Status Effect; Cannot use Gear

name: Affliction
effect: Target receives the Afflicted Status Effect; At the bottom of your turn, roll a die — on evens reduce WT by 1 until you roll again, on odds nothing happens.

name: Confuse
effect: Target receives the Confused Status Effect; On rolls, roll twice, take lower roll

name: Crush
effect: Target receives the Crushed Status Effect; Roll 1d6: on 1-2 lose your Movement Action, 3-4 lose your Non-Movement Action, 5-6 can't use Gear

name: Focus
effect: Target receives the Focused Status Effect; On rolls, roll twice, take higher roll

name: Distract
effect: Target receives the Distracted Status Effect; Must use all Actions (Free Actions included) during your Turn, no holding Actions.

name: Nullify
effect: Target receives the Nullified Status Effect; Cannot use Engrams

name: Zone Heal
effect: Heal any number of Targets in your Zone that much.

name: Discombobulate
effect: Target receives the Discombobulated Status Effect; On any Combat Action, roll 1d4 — on a 1, hit a random target

name: Expose
effect: Target receives the Exposed Status Effect; WT reduced by 1

name: Overheat
effect: Target receives the Overheated Status Effect; Cannot use Grit

name: Vampire
effect: Targets Wounds, Heal You

name: Shield
effect: Target receives the Shielded Status Effect; Target absorbs that many Wounds before reducing HP

name: Fortify
effect: Receive the Fortified Status Effect; WT increased by 1

name: Haste
effect: Receive the Hastened Status Effect; Gain an extra Movement Action each round this remains active

name: Rend & Tear
effect: Receive the Bleeding Status Effect; Lose 1 HP at the bottom of your turn

name: Charm
effect: Receive the Charmed Status Effect; Treat source as Friendly

name: Demoralize
effect: Receive the Demoralized Status Effect; Cannot Ganbare or receive Ganbare

name: Rattle
effect: Receive the Rattled Status Effect; Cannot use Overload

name: Irradiate
effect: Target receives the Irradiated Status Effect; Lose 1 Grit

name: Energize
effect: Receive the Energized Status Effect; Gain +1 Non-Movement Action

name: Desync
effect: Receive the Desynced Status Effect; Enhancer is Desynced

name: Terrify
effect: Target receives the Frightened Status Effect; Must remain Zone-adjacent to fear source

name: Hack
effect: If the Target fails the Save, control the Target for # of Turns, where # is a roll of xd4

name: Teleport
effect: Swap Positions with Target Ally
